program_name: Bachelor of Science in Cyber Security and IT Forensics

programme_facts.value: The BSc in Cyber Security and IT Forensics Degree in UL teaches how to build secure systems to protect vital information.

metadata.chunk_title: Why Study Cyber Security and IT Forensics at UL?

programme_facts.value: Cyber Security & IT Forensics prepares students for careers in security consulting, forensic analysis, secure design, programming, and e commerce protection.
Companies, governments, and research organisations are seeking professionals to design, manage, and secure networks and telecommunications systems.
